name: files
about: Make a small file and preview it. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

params.walk_tag: a short tag unique to this walk, e.g. the merge's short sha: it names what the walk makes so a later run can find it

gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 files/src/host.rs:1011, app_view.rs:416 — upload is drag-and-drop from the OS only ('Drop files here to upload'): no picker and no path field, so a file cannot be uploaded from the tree or by keys; the walk makes one with New file instead
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 files/src/inspector.rs:218-257 — a preview is a Surface: the file contents (text or picture) are not in the tree, only the facts and a size caption
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 files/src/inspector.rs:126-159 — the Edit editor has no label
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 files/src/listing.rs:275 — double-click to open is a MouseArea with no role

steps.say: open the Files tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Files tab is selected and the files view shows a New file button and a file list or its empty state; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading
a New file dialog shows a File name field and a Create file button

steps.say: type the file name into the File name field
steps.expect: the File name field holds qa-{param:walk_tag}.txt and Create file is enabled
the dialog closes and the list has a row named File qa-{param:walk_tag}.txt; no error
the inspector shows a title label qa-{param:walk_tag}.txt with Path, Kind and Size facts
